plain_language: Long-term national development goals set, including health.
A low-cost method to keep small babies warm rolled out and added to district budgets.
The analysis window opens; global Sustainable Development Goals set the under-12 newborn-death target for 2030.
National roadmap to cut maternal, newborn and child deaths.
Detailed newborn inpatient data (NID) starts at implementing hospitals, enabling cross-checks.
National survey measures newborn death rate at 24 per 1,000.
Ten-year analysis window closes; DHIS2 adjusted rate is 5.9 per 1,000.
Reduced survey funding after 2025 makes routine system data even more important.
Global goal: fewer than 12 newborn deaths per 1,000 live births.
